parameters.help_en:
The following management operations are supported for private custom RDS instances:
* **DescribeDBInstanceAttribute**: Queries the details of a private custom RDS instance.
* **DescribeAvailableClasses**: Queries the available instance types of a private custom RDS instance, including the instance type code and storage capacity.
* **DescribeSQLCollectorPolicy**: Queries the SQL Explorer (SQL audit) status of a private custom RDS instance.
* **ModifySQLCollectorPolicy**: Enables or disables the SQL Explorer (SQL audit) feature for a private custom RDS instance.
* **DescribeParameters**: Queries the current parameter settings of a private custom RDS instance.
* **ModifyParameter**: Modifies the parameters of a private custom RDS instance.
* **DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig**: Queries the high-availability mode and data replication mode of a private custom RDS instance.
* **SwitchDBInstanceHA**: Switches over the primary and secondary instances of a private custom RDS instance
parameters.help_zh:
当前支持对私有定制RDS实例执行如下管理操作：
* **DescribeDBInstanceAttribute**：查询私有定制RDS实例的详细信息。
* **DescribeAvailableClasses**：查询私有定制RDS实例可购买规格，包括规格代码和存储空间。
* **DescribeSQLCollectorPolicy**：查询私有定制RDS实例的SQL洞察（SQL审计）状态。
* **ModifySQLCollectorPolicy**：开启或关闭私有定制RDS实例的SQL洞察（SQL审计）功能。
* **DescribeParameters**：查询私有定制RDS实例当前的参数配置。
* **ModifyParameter**：修改私有定制RDS实例参数。
* **DescribeDBInstanceHAConfig**：查询私有定制RDS实例的高可用模式和数据复制方式。
* **SwitchDBInstanceHA**：切换私有定制RDS实例的主备实例
parameters.name: rds_action

parameters.help_en:
A JSON string that contains the request parameters and their values to be forwarded to the private custom RDS API operation. All parameter values must be of the STRING type. Example: `{NodeId:"1797****"}`.

For the request parameters and valid values of each private custom RDS API operation, see the request parameters section in the following topics:
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26231.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196546.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26292.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26293.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26285.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26286.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26244.html
* https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26251.html

> For the required request parameters of the preceding API operations, you do not need to specify the Action and DBInstanceId parameters. All other required request parameters must be specified
